name: 5-in-1 Heavy Furniture Mover Tool Set with Lifter & 360° Rollers
description:
Move heavy furniture with ease using this 5-in-1 Furniture Mover Tool Set. Designed with an ergonomic lifter and 360° rotating rollers, it helps you lift, slide, and reposition sofas, fridges, beds, and more without straining your back. Safe for all floor types, it makes rearranging or cleaning stress-free and convenient.
Key Features
 Supports up to 150kg load capacity
 Includes 5 heavy-duty rollers for smooth movement
 Ergonomic lever tool for easy lifting
 Floor-safe design for wood, tile, laminate & carpet
 Quick setup – no tools required
 Perfect for moving, rearranging & cleaning
Ingredients / Materials
Durable ABS plastic rollers, heavy-duty steel lifter, anti-slip rubber handle
How to Use
 Place lifter under the furniture edge
 Push down lever to raise furniture slightly
 Position the rollers at corners
 Slide furniture in any direction with ease
Package Includes
 1 × Furniture Lifter
 4 × 360° Rotating Rollers
